verdicts.reason: A is cramped. The headline almost touches the top edge and runs into the stacked circles, the body copy wraps into a squeezed three-line block, the CTA is oversized and pushed against the right edge over the circles, and the bottle nearly fills the full height. B has a clear left-to-right flow with the logo, headline and one-line body grouped and centred, plus a well-sized CTA. Its flaws: the bottle almost touches the top and bottom edges, there is a dead gap between the bottle and the copy, the body text is small, and the button slightly overlaps the green circle.
